module_summary: Two-phase clock-domain-crossing stream: a source-domain sender toggles an async request with held data and a destination-domain receiver synchronizes it and toggles an async acknowledge.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source-domain valid launching a transfer into the sender.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready when previous transfer acknowledged.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source payload latched by sender for crossing.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain valid after synchronized request toggle.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready completing handshake and toggling ack.

anchors.name: async_req
anchors.why: Toggling request crossing from source to destination domain.

anchors.name: async_ack
anchors.why: Toggling acknowledge crossing back to the source domain.

anchors.name: async_data
anchors.why: Data held stable by sender across the asynchronous boundary.

groups.name: Source-domain sender
groups.description: Accepts source valid/ready transfer, toggles request and holds data.

groups.name: Destination-domain receiver
groups.description: Synchronizes request, presents data valid, toggles ack on accept.

groups.name: Async two-phase link
groups.description: Request/ack toggles and stable data crossing clock domains.
